wands.name: Ace of Wands
wands.up: A spark lands: an idea, an invitation, a surge of wanting that feels alive. Say yes to the first small step while the fire is warm.
wands.rv: The spark struggles to catch: delays, mixed signals, or energy spent in the wrong direction. Wait for real heat rather than forcing smoke.
wands.love: Attraction with momentum; let it be playful before it is serious.
wands.career: Pitch it, start it, volunteer; raw initiative beats polish today.
wands.money: A bright idea is not a budget; seed it small and watch it.
wands.health: Energy returns when you move; start gently, then build.

wands.name: Two of Wands
wands.up: You hold the world loosely and look outward: two real paths, both viable. Plan past the horizon, then commit your weight to one.
wands.rv: The map stays folded: indecision, fear of the bigger life, or planning as a hiding place. Choose the path you can grow on.
wands.love: Deciding what you actually want precedes asking for it.
wands.career: Strategy day: compare the two roads with numbers, not moods.
wands.money: Long-view planning pays; avoid scattering small bets.
wands.health: A plan you can repeat beats a heroic one-day effort.

wands.name: Three of Wands
wands.up: What you launched is moving: early results, wider horizons, help from afar. Keep your eyes on the harbour and your hand steady.
wands.rv: Ships delayed and tempers short. Check what is actually blocked before blaming the wind; some of it is small thinking.
wands.love: Growth together, or love at a distance handled with patience.
wands.career: Expansion works; prepare the next stage before it lands.
wands.money: Returns are en route; do not spend the cargo before docking.
wands.health: Steady progress; widen the routine rather than intensifying it.

wands.name: Four of Wands
wands.up: A milestone worth marking: people gather, the roof holds, joy is communal. Celebrate properly; harmony is also an achievement.
wands.rv: The party feels off: restlessness at home or celebration postponed. Fix the small friction instead of faking the toast.
wands.love: Public joy as a couple, or welcoming someone into your circle.
wands.career: Team milestones count; thank people out loud.
wands.money: Spend on shared joy within limits; home costs stay planned.
wands.health: Rest inside community; celebration is recovery too.

wands.name: Five of Wands
wands.up: Sparks fly where ambitions collide: sparring, rivalry, everyone talking at once. Treat it as training, not war; the best idea can win.
wands.rv: The fight drains or dissolves: conflict avoided too long, or tension finally spent. Name the real disagreement while it is small.
wands.love: Sparring can be chemistry or combat; keep it kind and it stays play.
wands.career: Compete on merit; do not make rivals of teammates.
wands.money: Too many hands on one pot; agree the split before spending.
wands.health: Burn the static off with movement, not arguments.

wands.name: Six of Wands
wands.up: The crowd sees it: a win, praise, the ride through town. Accept recognition graciously; it fuels the next campaign.
wands.rv: Applause delayed or pride bruised: a win that feels hollow, or credit going elsewhere. Let results argue for you.
wands.love: Being chosen and shown off a little; enjoy being proud together.
wands.career: Visibility is high; document the win, share credit.
wands.money: A bonus or lift is possible; do not inflate lifestyle overnight.
wands.health: Confidence helps the body; avoid victory laps that injure.

wands.name: Seven of Wands
wands.up: You hold the hill: others want the spot, the budget, the say. Stand for what you built; conviction is a resource, spend it well.
wands.rv: Too many challengers, or the crouch becomes the position. Pick which ground is truly yours and let the rest go.
wands.love: Defend the relationship's boundaries, not your ego.
wands.career: Justify your call with calm facts; do not fight every critic.
wands.money: Guard the core budget; say no to raids dressed as favours.
wands.health: Sustainable effort beats heroic defence; rest is strategy.

wands.name: Eight of Wands
wands.up: Everything moves at once: messages, decisions, travel, momentum. Aim before the volley lands and ride the clear air.
wands.rv: Arrows scatter: delays, crossed wires, haste making waste. Slow the send button; one clear message beats eight fast ones.
wands.love: Fast developments; enjoy the rush, confirm the meaning.
wands.career: Green lights across the board; prioritise before pouncing.
wands.money: Quick moves possible; read the small print at speed, twice.
wands.health: Momentum is medicine; protect sleep while life accelerates.

wands.name: Nine of Wands
wands.up: Bandaged but standing: you are closer than you feel. One more honest push, with your guard up and your lesson learned.
wands.rv: The guard never lowers: exhaustion posing as vigilance. Rest is not surrender; let someone trusted hold the wall.
wands.love: Old wounds set the watch; let present kindness update the guard.
wands.career: Finish the campaign; document so the next push is lighter.
wands.money: Protect reserves; this is not the week for lending strength away.
wands.health: Recovery is the training now; sleep like it matters, it does.

wands.name: Ten of Wands
wands.up: The bundle is heavy because you picked up every stick. The work matters; the carrying style does not. Put some down before the last steps.
wands.rv: Release begins: delegating, dropping, saying the overdue no. Let the pile shrink to what is actually yours.
wands.love: Care shown as labour still needs words; share the load early.
wands.career: Delegate or renegotiate scope before burnout negotiates for you.
wands.money: Cut one recurring weight; effort is also a currency.
wands.health: The back keeps the score; lighten before it invoices you.

wands.name: Page of Wands
wands.up: A bright messenger: news that excites, a new interest, beginner's fire. Explore loudly, commit later.
wands.rv: Static on the line: hasty words, false alarms, enthusiasm without aim. Verify before you volley the news onward.
wands.love: Flirtation and spark; keep it light until it proves depth.
wands.career: Volunteer for the interesting task; curiosity is visible.
wands.money: Small exciting bets only; novelty is not due diligence.
wands.health: Try the new class, route, or recipe; play counts as training.

wands.name: Knight of Wands
wands.up: The charger arrives: adventure, travel, a bold move made at speed. Ride it where it counts; aim the horse before the gallop.
wands.rv: Hot hooves, cold hearth: reckless starts, restless exits, snags on the road. Slow down enough to actually arrive.
wands.love: Whirlwind energy; thrilling, and needs one honest conversation.
wands.career: Pitch boldly, chase the opening; follow-through sells it.
wands.money: Fast money tempts; speed is not a strategy.
wands.health: Channel the charge into sport before it becomes friction.

wands.name: Queen of Wands
wands.up: Warm authority: confidence that rooms can feel, creativity with a spine. Lead by lighting other candles, not dimming them.
wands.rv: The fire turns inward: jealousy, insecurity, or warmth with conditions. Refill your own cup before directing the room.
wands.love: Magnetic and generous; ask for admiration honestly, not by test.
wands.career: Visible leadership lands; mentor someone visibly too.
wands.money: Invest in presentation and people; both compound.
wands.health: Vitality loves rhythm: sun, movement, colour, company.

wands.name: King of Wands
wands.up: The long view with fire behind it: vision people can follow, risks taken on purpose. Lead the campaign, not every skirmish.
wands.rv: Vision curdles into overreach: impulsive calls, a court that only cheers. Invite one honest dissent before deciding.
wands.love: Generous leadership at home; make room for another throne.
wands.career: Set the direction publicly; hire or delegate the how.
wands.money: Big-picture bets need boring safeguards; pair them.
wands.health: Sustainable pace is the real flex; protect the engine.

cups.name: Ace of Cups
cups.up: The cup fills from inside: new love, friendship, faith, or simply feeling again. Let it overflow toward someone.
cups.rv: The cup is covered: feelings blocked, numb, or poured where they are not met. Name the feeling before filling anything.
cups.love: A genuine opening; say the soft thing first.
cups.career: Work with heart in it appears; follow meaning, then money.
cups.money: Generosity flows; give from surplus, not from guilt.
cups.health: Emotional rest is physical rest; cry, laugh, hydrate.

cups.name: Two of Cups
cups.up: Two cups, raised level: partnership with mutual respect, a bond that pours both ways. Meet them halfway, exactly halfway.
cups.rv: One cup pours, the other watches: imbalance, a truce cooling, or a bond needing repair. Check the levels honestly.
cups.love: The real thing has reciprocity; look for effort that matches yours.
cups.career: A 1:1 alliance strengthens; put the understanding in writing.
cups.money: Shared finances need shared rules; agree them kindly.
cups.health: Heal in company; ask for the specific help you need.

cups.name: Three of Cups
cups.up: Raise it with your people: friendship, reunion, shared joy multiplied. Community is the blessing here, not background.
cups.rv: The toast sours slightly: gossip, a third wheel, or one toast too many. Keep the circle kind and the cup moderate.
cups.love: Love inside a happy circle; friends are part of the romance.
cups.career: Celebrate the team win; networks quietly open doors.
cups.money: Group spending is joyful and slippery; set the kitty rules.
cups.health: Joy is contagious medicine; schedule your people.

cups.name: Four of Cups
cups.up: Arms crossed under the tree: boredom, apathy, an offer unnoticed at your elbow. Look up before concluding life is flat.
cups.rv: The fog lifts: interest returns, the offered cup finally seen. Say yes to one small thing and watch appetite follow.
cups.love: Emotional flatness is information, not verdict; say what is missing.
cups.career: A dull patch hides an opening; review the unnoticed offer.
cups.money: Avoid apathy spending; check the account you have been ignoring.
cups.health: Low mood is a signal; light, air, and one person help.

cups.name: Five of Cups
cups.up: Three cups down, and grief is honest work. Two still stand behind you: grieve what spilled, then turn around; the bridge is there.
cups.rv: The turn begins: regret loosening, help accepted, the walk back over the bridge. Let the past be a place you visited.
cups.love: Sorrow needs witnessing, not fixing; stay or be stayed with.
cups.career: A setback is not the whole portfolio; salvage what stands.
cups.money: Count what remains before mourning what left; rebuild from the two cups.
cups.health: Grief lives in the body; gentle routines carry it.

cups.name: Six of Cups
cups.up: Sweet water from an old well: nostalgia, old friends, places that knew you young. Visit warmly; bring something back.
cups.rv: The past will not move out: rose-tinted traps or an old story driving. Thank it, then return to the present tense.
cups.love: An old flame or an old softness in a current love; check which.
cups.career: Past skills and contacts resurface usefully; call them.
cups.money: Old debts or gifts resurface; settle them cleanly.
cups.health: Comfort rituals from childhood still work; use them kindly.

cups.name: Seven of Cups
cups.up: Seven cups shimmer with dragons and jewels alike: many options, not all real. Choose by the life you want, not the sparkle.
cups.rv: The mist thins: one wish proves true, the rest were weather. Commit to the real cup and let fantasies retire.
cups.love: Projecting is easy now; ask who they are, not who they gleam as.
cups.career: Too many shiny paths; score them against one clear goal.
cups.money: Avoid glittering schemes; boring and real wins.
cups.health: Decision fatigue is real; fewer choices, deeper rest.

cups.name: Eight of Cups
cups.up: Eight cups stacked neatly, and still you walk: leaving the almost-right for the true thing. The moonlit road is the honest one.
cups.rv: Half out the door: fear of change or drifting back to the familiar cups. Decide what would make staying different, or go kindly.
cups.love: Leaving what almost worked takes more love, not less.
cups.career: A role that no longer feeds you; plan the exit with grace.
cups.money: Walk from sunk costs; the moon is not an expense line.
cups.health: Restlessness is data; the body wants a truer routine.

cups.name: Nine of Cups
cups.up: The wish card: contentment you can taste, pride in what fills your table. Ask clearly; gratitude seasons it.
cups.rv: Full cup, flat taste: getting it did not feed you, or wanting crowds out having. Revisit what the wish was for.
cups.love: Emotional generosity attracts; enjoy being delighted in.
cups.career: A goal lands; savour before sprinting to the next.
cups.money: Comfort is real now; keep one wish funded, not five.
cups.health: Pleasure is part of health; schedule it without apology.

cups.name: Ten of Cups
cups.up: Rainbow over the house: lasting joy, chosen family, love that includes the ordinary days. Build the home scenes you keep picturing.
cups.rv: Weather inside the house: values clashing or harmony performed for show. Real repair starts with one honest table conversation.
cups.love: The long-game card: tend the daily, not just the milestone.
cups.career: Success that includes home life is the brief; protect both.
cups.money: Household alignment on money creates the actual wealth.
cups.health: Belonging is a health metric; invest in your people.

cups.name: Page of Cups
cups.up: A tender message surfaces: an apology, an idea, a feeling with a fish in it. Stay curious; sensitivity is the instrument.
cups.rv: Static on the heart line: moody news, feelings performed or blocked. Wait for the sincere version before reacting.
cups.love: Sweet, shy openings; gentleness lands better than grand gestures.
cups.career: Creative hunches deserve one small test, not a launch.
cups.money: Do not lend on a feeling; check the facts with love.
cups.health: Name the feeling in one sentence; the body relaxes.

cups.name: Knight of Cups
cups.up: The romantic rider: an offer, invitation, or quest of the heart, delivered gracefully. Let feeling propose; let sense sign.
cups.rv: The tide brings foam: moody offers, grand words, weather instead of climate. Judge by follow-through, not poetry.
cups.love: Someone leads with their heart; meet sincerity with sincerity.
cups.career: Pitch with story and grace; charm opens, craft closes.
cups.money: Beware beautiful pitches; romance is not due diligence.
cups.health: Moods move like weather; routines are the climate you control.

cups.name: Queen of Cups
cups.up: The sea-queen: compassion with depth perception, intuition you can steer by. Listen below the words; counsel gently.
cups.rv: The tide comes inside: overwhelm, codependence, boundaries dissolved. Your feelings are data, not duties.
cups.love: Deep attunement is your gift; do not disappear into their weather.
cups.career: Emotional intelligence is the strategy; use it openly.
cups.money: Generosity with boundaries keeps the well full.
cups.health: Solitude refills what empathy spends; book it.

cups.name: King of Cups
cups.up: The calm king: feelings mastered, not muted; diplomacy with a pulse. Steer the room by steadiness, not volume.
cups.rv: The lid sits tight: feelings suppressed or used as leverage. Thaw one honest conversation before deciding anything big.
cups.love: Steady devotion wins; say the warm thing out loud too.
cups.career: Negotiate from calm; your steadiness is the offer.
cups.money: Unemotional money decisions, reviewed on schedule.
cups.health: What is swallowed sits somewhere; give it words and water.

swords.name: Ace of Swords
swords.up: One clean cut: clarity, a truth named, a mind made up. Use the sword for surgery, not war; the first honest sentence changes everything.
swords.rv: The blade is fogged: confusion, mixed facts, or a truth landing badly. Gather real information before swinging.
swords.love: One honest conversation clears months of weather.
swords.career: Decide, document, communicate once and clearly.
swords.money: Read the contract; the truth is in clause three.
swords.health: Name the worry precisely; vague dread shrinks when written.

swords.name: Two of Swords
swords.up: Blindfold on, blades crossed: a truce that is really a postponed choice. Peace kept by not-looking has an expiry date; choose your timing, then look.
swords.rv: The blindfold slips: too much information, or the choice finally made. Breathe; deciding badly beats starving between doors.
swords.love: An unspoken thing guards the peace; it costs more each week.
swords.career: Two options, one deadline; use criteria, not comfort.
swords.money: Avoiding the statement is still a decision; open it.
swords.health: Mental rest needs the loop closed; decide or schedule the deciding.

swords.name: Three of Swords
swords.up: The heart-piercing card: sorrow, betrayal, or a truth that hurts to hear. Rain is part of it; grief is not a malfunction, and it does move through.
swords.rv: The swords come out one by one: healing, forgiveness offered or accepted, pain leaving the body. Let the scar be a seam, not a vault.
swords.love: Heartbreak needs honesty and time; do not rush the stitching.
swords.career: Painful feedback may be accurate; extract the useful third.
swords.money: A loss hurts; count it once, learn it once, stop re-paying it.
swords.health: Grief and stress are physical; rest like it is treatment.

swords.name: Four of Swords
swords.up: The knight lies down on purpose: rest, recovery, a mind stood down. Retreat is the strategy; the sword hangs within reach, not in hand.
swords.rv: Rest refused or interrupted: the mind keeps fencing in bed. Protect the recovery window like an appointment with yourself.
swords.love: Quiet togetherness heals more than processing everything tonight.
swords.career: Strategic pause before the next campaign; sharpen offline.
swords.money: No big decisions from exhaustion; sleep on every signature.
swords.health: Actual rest: horizontal, unhurried, screens elsewhere.

swords.name: Five of Swords
swords.up: Won, and the field looks like that: a victory whose price was people. Pick up only the swords that are yours; some wins to decline next time.
swords.rv: Smoke after the fight: resentment lingering, or a genuine attempt to reconcile. Bury the weapons you keep tripping over.
swords.love: Being right at that volume costs the relationship; choose the us.
swords.career: Win the point, keep the room; you will need these people.
swords.money: Do not win a refund and lose a relationship worth more.
swords.health: Conflict hormones are expensive; discharge them kindly.

swords.name: Six of Swords
swords.up: A quiet boat to calmer water: transition, recovery, leaving turbulence without a scene. Healing is often just steady rowing.
swords.rv: The boat circles: unfinished business, baggage riding along, or resisting the crossing you chose. Name what is still aboard.
swords.love: Moving on together, or apart, with dignity intact.
swords.career: A gradual move beats a dramatic quit; row, do not leap.
swords.money: Slow improvement is real improvement; keep the route boring.
swords.health: Recovery is a crossing, not a switch; pace the oars.

swords.name: Seven of Swords
swords.up: The quiet exit with armfuls of swords: strategy, discretion, solving it your own way. Clever is fine; keep it honest with yourself about why solo.
swords.rv: The plan surfaces: conscience, exposure, or a shortcut repriced. Coming clean early is cheaper than being found out.
swords.love: Something unsaid is tiptoeing; bring it into the room kindly.
swords.career: Work the angle, document your part; lone-wolf has limits.
swords.money: Check the quiet leak; small print and small print only.
swords.health: Avoiding the check-up is also a strategy; pick a better one.

swords.name: Eight of Swords
swords.up: Bound and blindfolded among swords that are not even planted deep: restriction that feels total and is mostly perspective. One small step proves the ropes are loose.
swords.rv: The blindfold comes off by your own hand: liberation, a door noticed, help accepted. Walk; the swords stay behind.
swords.love: Feeling trapped deserves a witness; say it before it hardens.
swords.career: The constraint is real but partial; find the unguarded degree of freedom.
swords.money: Feeling stuck is not a spreadsheet; list actual options.
swords.health: Small agency is medicine; one doable change today.

swords.name: Nine of Swords
swords.up: 3 a.m. with every worst case queued: anxiety, guilt, the loop that feels like fact. It is a feeling with good stamina, not a prophecy; morning edits it.
swords.rv: The night loosens: worry named, help accepted, dawn doing its work. Tell one person the actual fear; it shrinks in daylight.
swords.love: Do not sentence the relationship at 3 a.m.; revisit at breakfast.
swords.career: Write the worst case and its plan; the loop hates paper.
swords.money: Night arithmetic lies; check balances in daylight only.
swords.health: Sleep hygiene is the treatment plan; screens down, worry journal out.

swords.name: Ten of Swords
swords.up: Face down at the bottom, and the sky is already lightening: a painful ending that is, mercifully, an ending. What is finished cannot keep happening to you; rise slowly.
swords.rv: Getting up with swords still being removed: survival mode, recovery in progress. You do not have to be inspiring yet; standing is enough.
swords.love: An ending can be mercy; let it end all the way.
swords.career: The collapsed thing frees your hands; inventory what you learned.
swords.money: Rock bottom is a floor, not a home; rebuild one brick of routine.
swords.health: Rest like recovery, not defeat; the body believes in dawn.

swords.name: Page of Swords
swords.up: The watchful student: questions, research, a mind testing the wind. Curiosity with a notebook beats opinion with a megaphone.
swords.rv: The blade is all edge: gossip, cynicism, surveillance dressed as care. Aim the sharp mind at ideas, not people.
swords.love: Ask the real question instead of testing them.
swords.career: Research first, speak second; your draft improves.
swords.money: Investigate before investing; forums are not advisors.
swords.health: Dr. Internet says rest first; then verify with a human.

swords.name: Knight of Swords
swords.up: Charging with the sword up: fast decisions, direct speech, a debate won at gallop. Aim carefully; at this speed, words land as actions.
swords.rv: All charge, no map: reckless words, arguments for sport, haste scattering the plan. Rein in for one breath before the next sentence.
swords.love: Bluntness is not honesty; land the truth with its parachute.
swords.career: Move fast on the decision, slow on the announcement.
swords.money: Impulse trades and purchases both charge interest.
swords.health: Adrenaline is a loan; repay with downshift time.

swords.name: Queen of Swords
swords.up: Clear eyes, kind blade: independence earned through experience, counsel that cuts cleanly. Your perception is the gift; deliver it warm.
swords.rv: The wit grows walls: bitterness, cold judgment, honesty as armour. Soften the delivery without dulling the truth.
swords.love: Directness is attractive; add one degree of warmth.
swords.career: Your review saves projects; phrase the cut as care.
swords.money: Sentiment-free review of the numbers, once a month.
swords.health: Grief unspoken becomes sharpness; give it words privately.

swords.name: King of Swords
swords.up: The judge-king: reason with authority, decisions that hold because they are fair. Think it through, state it once, stand by the standard.
swords.rv: Intellect as armour or lever: cold control, rules bent by cleverness. Fairness includes the cases you dislike.
swords.love: Lead with logic, stay for the feeling underneath it.
swords.career: Your call sets precedent; document the principle.
swords.money: Systems over impulses; let the policy decide at 3 a.m.
swords.health: The mind's verdicts are not the body's; listen downstairs too.

pentacles.name: Ace of Pentacles
pentacles.up: A solid coin in an open hand: a job, offer, or resource with real weight. Plant it properly; this seed likes good soil and patience.
pentacles.rv: The coin slips or the soil is wrong: missed chance, shaky plan, money promised loosely. Nail the terms before the handshake fades.
pentacles.love: Love with building plans; small reliabilities are romantic.
pentacles.career: A tangible opening; take it and do the paperwork beautifully.
pentacles.money: Seed money rules: start, automate, do not admire it daily.
pentacles.health: One sustainable habit started today outweighs a overhaul.

pentacles.name: Two of Pentacles
pentacles.up: Two coins, one infinity loop: juggling money, time, and tides with a grin. Keep the rhythm; drop nothing by adding slowly.
pentacles.rv: A ball bounces away: too much, too uneven, the loop wobbling. Set one coin down on purpose before gravity chooses.
pentacles.love: Make room on the actual calendar; love is also logistics.
pentacles.career: Prioritise in pencil; everything is not a ball, some are stones.
pentacles.money: Cash-flow juggling needs a buffer, not better reflexes.
pentacles.health: Energy is a resource; budget it like money.

pentacles.name: Three of Pentacles
pentacles.up: Blueprints out, craftspeople talking: skill meeting teamwork, work that will outlast moods. Build with people who respect the plan.
pentacles.rv: The build site bickers: roles unclear, skill unvalued, plans ignored. Re-draw who does what, in writing, kindly.
pentacles.love: Build something together; shared projects are glue.
pentacles.career: Your craft plus their structure; ask for the brief in writing.
pentacles.money: Collaborative income needs clear splits from day one.
pentacles.health: Train with others; accountability is a structure too.

pentacles.name: Four of Pentacles
pentacles.up: Coins clutched to chest, head, and feet: security guarded hard, control mistaken for safety. What you own should not own your posture.
pentacles.rv: The grip softens: generosity, spending on purpose, control released where it was only fear. Open one hand and watch nothing fall.
pentacles.love: Possessiveness is fear in a crown; trust is the braver hold.
pentacles.career: Guard the core, delegate the edges; hoarded work stalls growth.
pentacles.money: Saving is wise; squeezing is different. Fund one joy line.
pentacles.health: Tension is a full-body budget item; unclench deliberately.

pentacles.name: Five of Pentacles
pentacles.up: Snow outside the warm window: hardship, money worry, feeling left out. The lighted window is the point; help exists and asking is allowed.
pentacles.rv: The thaw begins: improvement, help accepted, a door opening from inside. Walk toward the warmth without apologising for the cold.
pentacles.love: Hard times are a we-thing; say which part is heaviest.
pentacles.career: Ask for the reference, the intro, the ramp; pride is expensive.
pentacles.money: Hardship maths first: essentials, then one call to negotiate.
pentacles.health: Do not skip care for cost alone; ask what options exist.

pentacles.name: Six of Pentacles
pentacles.up: Coins weighed and shared: generosity, patronage, fair exchange flowing the right way. Give cleanly or receive cleanly; both are skills.
pentacles.rv: The scales tilt: strings attached, debt with interest of the soul, giving to control. Rebalance the exchange or decline it kindly.
pentacles.love: Care should circulate, not accumulate as debt.
pentacles.career: Mentorship and fair pay both appear; be the scale, not the thumb.
pentacles.money: Lend what you can gift; gift what you can forget.
pentacles.health: Accept help as maintenance, not defeat.

pentacles.name: Seven of Pentacles
pentacles.up: Leaning on the hoe, reading the garden: pause, assess, let compounding work. Not every quiet field is failing; some are rooting.
pentacles.rv: Staring at the plants will not hurry them: impatience, sunk-cost fretting, tending what should be replanted. Review honestly, then commit or compost.
pentacles.love: Long games need small waterings; check what is actually growing.
pentacles.career: Quarterly honesty: keep, fix, or stop; do not just hover.
pentacles.money: Investments need seasons; check the soil, not the hour.
pentacles.health: Fitness compounds quietly; the mirror is a lagging indicator.

pentacles.name: Eight of Pentacles
pentacles.up: Coin after coin, each better: apprenticeship, repetition, craft compounding. Mastery is a pile of ordinary days done carefully.
pentacles.rv: The chisel slips: perfectionism, shortcuts, or grind without pride. Return to the standard you respect, one coin at a time.
pentacles.love: Love is also a practice; small repeated kindnesses are the craft.
pentacles.career: Ship the reps; skill is visibly compounding, keep going.
pentacles.money: Earn the raise with documented craft, then ask.
pentacles.health: Technique before intensity; the body loves correct reps.

pentacles.name: Nine of Pentacles
pentacles.up: In the garden, robed in what she built: abundance earned, self-reliance with good taste. Enjoy it without explaining it.
pentacles.rv: The garden needs the gardener less weary: overwork, comfort bought at body prices, or a setback to luxuries. Reinvest in rest.
pentacles.love: Whole on your own, generous in company; standards are kind.
pentacles.career: Your track record is the pitch; let it speak first.
pentacles.money: Comfort is funded; keep the boring system that built it.
pentacles.health: Pleasure and rest are part of the portfolio now.

pentacles.name: Ten of Pentacles
pentacles.up: Three generations under one arch: wealth that means security shared, legacy being built in ordinary kindnesses. Think in decades, act today.
pentacles.rv: The arch strains: family money friction, inheritance of stress rather than ease. Clarity and kindness, in writing, early.
pentacles.love: Building a household is a long poem; write it together.
pentacles.career: Build the thing that outlasts your role in it.
pentacles.money: Family money talks go better before they are urgent.
pentacles.health: Health is the first inheritance; model it at home.

pentacles.name: Page of Pentacles
pentacles.up: The student with a coin held like a question: a course, an offer, a practical beginning. Do the homework; this one rewards diligence.
pentacles.rv: The notebook stays shut: procrastination, plans admired instead of started. Open to page one and do the smallest assignment.
pentacles.love: Show interest in their actual world; reliability is attractive.
pentacles.career: Apply, enrol, submit; the form is the first exam.
pentacles.money: Learn the instrument before buying it; one lesson first.
pentacles.health: Track one metric for two weeks; studentship beats intensity.

pentacles.name: Knight of Pentacles
pentacles.up: The slowest knight, the surest arrival: method, routine, promises kept in weather. Boring on paper, bankable in life.
pentacles.rv: The plough will not turn: stubbornness, stagnation, or work eating every other field. Same effort, one new furrow.
pentacles.love: Show up again; steadiness is a love language.
pentacles.career: Your reliability is promotable; make it visible, not just real.
pentacles.money: Automatic beats heroic; raise the transfer by a little.
pentacles.health: Consistency over intensity, every ordinary day.

pentacles.name: Queen of Pentacles
pentacles.up: The garden-queen: care made tangible, resources made warm, a home that runs on competence and kindness. Nourish, including yourself in the list.
pentacles.rv: The garden eats the gardener: care as control, work-home blur, self last on the list. Your name goes on the watering rota too.
pentacles.love: Feed people well, then sit down and be fed too.
pentacles.career: Operational kindness scales; systemise the care you give.
pentacles.money: A budget with warmth in it survives contact with life.
pentacles.health: Caregiver, care for the caregiver; book your own check-up.

pentacles.name: King of Pentacles
pentacles.up: The builder-king among vines and ledgers: prosperity through discipline, success that feeds people. Security is a craft; you practice it daily.
pentacles.rv: The ledger eats the kingdom: greed, work obsession, providing things instead of presence. Audit what the success is for.
pentacles.love: Provide presence first; the rest is garnish.
pentacles.career: Your systems create safety; teach them, do not hoard them.
pentacles.money: Wealth with a purpose clause outlives wealth with a scoreboard.
pentacles.health: The body is the founding asset; board meetings can wait.
